title: Accounting Information Systems 2
duration: 30 hours of lectures, 90 hours of self-study, 15 hours of discussion/practice

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Internal Control and Accounting Information Systems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe basic activities and related objects in business processes for organizing and performing accounting tasks and various types of audits.
Organize basic data and document flows in business processes to provide information for decision-making.
Analyze and evaluate activities in businesses and propose improvements for audit subjects and objects.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate the application of policies and analyze risks in accounting information systems.
Practice systematic thinking in organizing appropriate accounting information systems for business processes at enterprises.
Organize planning, coordination, management of resources, evaluation, and improvement of activities.
